verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair question for an online tax-services portal, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no capability for users to define rules that trigger actions on events. The only automation-related item is opting into automatic direct debit for the CFE tax (prélèvement automatique de la CFE). That is a fixed payment option, not a user-defined rule engine, so it earns no credit as an adjacent feature.
